jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
The Company

At Nylas, we specialize in making it easier for developers to add email, calendar, and contact management features into their applications. We provide APIs, which streamline the integration of these functionalities, ensuring they are secure and effective. This enables better, safer, and more reliable communication within apps.

Supporting over 100,000 developers and collaborating with more than 900 companies globally, Nylas plays a pivotal role in how digital communication tools are built and utilized. Our technology spans various sectors, from healthcare to education, simplifying the complex process of app development related to communications. By reducing the barriers in communication technology, we empower developers to innovate and enhance user interaction across platforms.



The Team

We are a team of strategic storytellers, customer advocates, and market experts who thrive on translating complex ideas into compelling narratives. Fueled by curiosity and a passion for impact, we take pride in helping our customers and go-to-market teams unlock the full potential of the Nylas platform.

The Product Marketing team serves as a critical bridge between our product, sales, and customer success teams, ensuring a seamless connection between what we build and how we position it in the market. We craft messaging that resonates, drive go-to-market strategy, and deliver insights that shape product innovation. Together, we create a culture of collaboration, data-driven decision-making, and a shared commitment to excellence.

Our goal is to empower our customers and internal teams with the knowledge, tools, and strategies they need to win, while fostering a team culture of creativity, growth, and continuous learning. If you thrive in a dynamic environment where your work drives business impact and market differentiation, you’ll find a rewarding home with us.



The Role

We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to support go-to-market strategies, product positioning, and sales enablement for the Nylas platform. This is a highly strategic role that requires deep experience in product marketing, a strong understanding of the developer-focused SaaS landscape, and a proven ability to drive revenue through compelling positioning, messaging, and execution.

As a Product Marketing Manager, you will partner with our Sr. Product Marketing Manager to own the development and execution of marketing strategies that resonate with our target customers, influence our roadmap, and enable our go-to-market teams. You’ll partner closely with Product, Sales, and Customer Success teams to drive adoption, market expansion, and revenue growth.  



What You’ll Do

 - Customer Insights & Voice of Customer – Lead a structured customer research program across segments and ICPs to deeply understand how teams build, adopt, and scale communications and AI-driven workflows. Conduct regular interviews with customers, prospects, and churned accounts to surface actionable insights that inform messaging, product direction, and go-to-market strategy.

 - Customer Advisory Program – Own and operate Nylas’ Customer Advisory Board, managing a regular forum for strategic customers to engage directly with our product team. Facilitate roadmap reviews, structured feedback sessions, and ongoing dialogue to ensure customer needs are clearly represented and influence product direction, while synthesizing feedback into clear, actionable inputs for Product.

 - Customer Stories & Proof Points – Own the development of high-impact case studies, customer narratives, and reference programs that demonstrate real-world value. Translate technical implementations into clear business outcomes for both developer and product leader audiences.

 - Competitive Intelligence & Battlecards – Drive ongoing competitive analysis across direct and adjacent players. Build and maintain battlecards, objection handling frameworks, and win/loss insights that enable sales and customer-facing teams to position Nylas effectively in competitive deals.

 - Customer Adoption & Lifecycle Programs – Design and execute programs that improve activation, adoption, and expansion across the customer lifecycle. This includes email-based onboarding and nurture programs, in-product and post-sale education, and targeted campaigns that drive utilization of key features.

 - Customer Enablement & Education – Partner with Sales and Customer Success to develop enablement materials, product work sessions, and customer-facing resources that help teams successfully implement and scale with Nylas, with a focus on reducing time-to-value and increasing long-term retention.

 - Growth and Demand Focus – Continuously refine ICP definitions, segmentation, and messaging based on customer insights, usage patterns, and deal feedback. Partner closely with Sales and Product to ensure product and positioning aligns with real buyer needs and market dynamics, supporting end-to-end go-to-market execution.

 - Performance Metrics & Optimization – Define key success metrics, analyze performance data, and refine marketing strategies based on insights.



What You Must Bring

 - Experience – 3-5+ years of product marketing experience in B2B SaaS, with a strong preference for developer-focused, API-driven, or technical platforms.

 - AI-Obsessed - Deep proficiency with AI tools for research, content, and workflows.

 - Strategic Leadership – Proven ability to develop and execute go-to-market strategies at scale, driving measurable business impact.

 - Technical Acumen – Strong understanding of APIs, developer ecosystems, and cloud-based platforms. Ability to translate technical capabilities into customer value propositions.

 - Sales & GTM Collaboration – Experience working closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams to drive revenue and adoption.

 - Analytical & Data-Driven – Expertise in market research, customer insights, and performance analytics to inform strategy.

 - Communication & Storytelling – Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with experience crafting compelling narratives for executive, sales, and customer audiences.

 - Cross-Functional Influence – Ability to work across departments and influence senior stakeholders to align on strategy and execution.

 - Education – Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field; MBA or equivalent experience preferred.



Interview Process (subject to change)

 - Round 1: 30 minute Google Meet discussion with the hiring manager

 - Round 2: Take home assignment to be followed by a 60-minute Google Meet panel discussion

 - Round 3:  45 minute Google Meet interviews with 3-4 team members (max 4 hours).

During the various discussions, candidates selected to meet with us are strongly encouraged to not only discuss their knowledge, skills, experience, and abilities but also to showcase examples of their current or previous work. We expect you to clearly outline the "what," "why," and "how" behind your contributions.

Actual compensation will be determined based on individual qualifications, which are objectively assessed during the interview process. Factors influencing salary include knowledge, skills, experience, and abilities.



Nylas is registered as an employer in many, but not all, states/provinces. If you are not located in or able to work from a state/province where Nylas is registered, you will not be eligible for employment. Visa sponsorship may not be available in certain remote locations.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
The Company

At Nylas, we specialize in making it easier for developers to add email, calendar, and contact management features into their applications. We provide APIs, which streamline the integration of these functionalities, ensuring they are secure and effective. This enables better, safer, and more reliable communication within apps.

Supporting over 100,000 developers and collaborating with more than 900 companies globally, Nylas plays a pivotal role in how digital communication tools are built and utilized. Our technology spans various sectors, from healthcare to education, simplifying the complex process of app development related to communications. By reducing the barriers in communication technology, we empower developers to innovate and enhance user interaction across platforms.




THE TEAM

We're looking for a Product Manager who is going to usher in the new era of integrating with communication data.

We operate with a founder's mindset. You'll own outcomes end-to-end, from early discovery through shipping and scaling, with the autonomy to move fast and the judgment to know when to slow down. We share wins, dissect failures, and hold a high bar for what a developer platform can be.

If you're the kind of person who spots an opportunity on Monday and has a working prototype by Tuesday, you'll fit right in.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Partner with leadership to define and execute on a particular area of the product portfolio that you own, keeping in line with the broader company objectives of unlocking AI utility, owning the AI agent comms harness, and making Nylas the fastest time to value for AI-based workflows.

 - Formulate technically complex and nuanced subject matter into clear business value. You can make sense of a deeply technical domain, reason through it, and translate it into a confident business bet.

 - Roll up your sleeves with Marketing to co-own GTM strategy, shaping how Nylas is positioned in a fast-moving AI landscape, crafting narratives that resonate with developers, and driving execution through launch and beyond.

 - Deeply understand how developers are building AI-powered applications today: what they're reaching for, where they're getting stuck, and where Nylas can become an indispensable part of that stack.

 - Lead discovery with our developer community and enterprise partners through closed betas, feedback loops, and continuous validation, building what the market needs before they can articulate it.

 - Own the documentation and launch lifecycle, ensuring every release sets a new standard for developer experience.

 - Move fast on low-risk problems. Don't wait when you can act.
   


THE IDEAL CANDIDATE:

 - Problem-led thinking is non-negotiable. You identify and articulate user problems clearly before reaching for solutions. Your work history reflects outcomes, not just output. You can point to metrics that moved, not just features that shipped.

 - You are genuinely plugged into how AI is changing software development. Not because your last job required it, because you're drawn to it. You're experimenting with tools like Claude Code, Codex, or similar in your own time. You have a nuanced understanding of the AI landscape, concepts such as LLMs, agents, RAG, and embeddings, and can speak to these with depth, not just vocabulary. If you've operationalized AI-based features or built pipelines in a professional context, even better.

 - You have a builder's instincts. You don't wait for a designer to be free before moving on a prototype. You don't wait for an engineer to run an audit, you can orchestrate yourself. You know the difference between what requires a specialist and what you can unblock with the right tools and good judgment. You operate within safe boundaries, but you push those boundaries as far as they reasonably go.

 - You have strong developer empathy. You understand how developers evaluate tools, make build-vs-buy decisions, and think about integrating third-party infrastructure into their products. You don't need to have come from a connectivity or API company, but you need to understand the developer mindset deeply, especially as it's evolving in the AI era.



What You Must Bring

 - 3+ years of product management experience working on technical products

 - Background in software engineering, technical product development, or demonstrated builder experience inside or outside of work

 - Experience collaborating closely with engineering teams on requirements, trade-offs, and technical risks

 - Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders

 - Comfort operating with ambiguity and incomplete information

Bonus Points

 - Experience shipping AI-powered features, workflows, or developer tools

 - Experience taking products from 0 → 1 in either a professional or personal capacity

 - Experience working with APIs, developer platforms, or infrastructure products
   
   

Interview Process

 - Round 1 - The Intro: 30 minute discussion with the Hiring Manager

 - Round 2 - The Deep Dive: Take home assignment to be followed by a 60 minute presentation with a panel

 - Round 3- The Loop:  A series of 45-minute chats with the team (max 3 hours) where we look for the "what, why, and how" behind your best work.



During the various discussions, candidates selected to meet with us are strongly encouraged to not only discuss their knowledge, skills, experience, and abilities but also to showcase examples of their current or previous work. We expect you to clearly outline the "what," "why," and "how" behind your contributions.



The estimated base salary range for this position is $120,000 - 160,000 CAD. Actual compensation will be determined based on individual qualifications, which are objectively assessed during the interview process. Factors influencing salary include knowledge, skills, experience, and abilities.



Nylas is registered as an employer in many, but not all, states/provinces. If you are not located in or able to work from a state/province where Nylas is registered, you will not be eligible for employment. Visa sponsorship may not be available in certain remote locations.
